tools.name: get_today
tools.description: Today's briefing, in the order to work it: overdue items (tasks, carried-forward tasks, review points I owe, follow-ups), due today, work papers waiting for my review, chases due today (grouped by client contact; items with no contact listed separately), work plan steps unlocked since yesterday, review points I owe, and past meetings.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Find records by text across engagements, tasks, work papers, review points, RFI items, work plan steps, follow-ups and people. Returns ids for use with other tools.

query.description: Text to look for; empty string lists everything in the chosen tables

tools.name: create_engagement
tools.description: Create an engagement/assignment (e.g. a deal code name like 'Project Falcon', or a client name) with its type, status, lead and team. For a whole team allocation sheet, call this once per assignment (or update_engagement if it already exists).

type.description: e.g. Due Diligence, Transaction Support, Stat Audit, Internal Audit, ITR

lead.description: Who leads it; omit or 'me' when the user leads it

team.description: Team member names; new names become team contacts

workstreams.description: e.g. QoE, NWC, Net debt, Tax

tools.name: update_engagement
tools.description: Change an engagement's status, type, lead, team, dates or details. `team` replaces the whole team; use addToTeam/removeFromTeam for single changes.

team.description: Full team (names), replacing the current one

tools.name: add_person
tools.description: Add a contact: a client contact, manager, partner or team member.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a to-do, call or meeting. When the user gives a time ("call Rahul at 3pm", "review meeting 10:30-11:30"), set due AND time (and durationMinutes if an end time or length is given): it is then added to their Google Calendar at that time with a reminder. Assign it to a team member to track work you've pushed to them.

time.description: Start time, 24h HH:mm, e.g. 15:00. Requires due.

assignee.description: Team member name or id; omit for me

tools.name: update_task
tools.description: Edit a task (title, date, time, length, priority) or mark it done. Set time to "" to make it untimed again.

time.description: Start time HH:mm, or "" to remove

tools.name: create_workpaper
tools.description: Create a work paper for the worksteps it covers. Pass `steps` (step numbers like '7.1' or ids) or `adHoc: true` for one not linked to any step; with neither, nothing is created and the engagement's unlinked steps come back so you can ask the user which ones. Ref, title, preparer and reviewer default from the steps.

steps.description: Worksteps it covers: numbers ('4.1') or ids

adHoc.description: True only when the user says it covers no workstep

ref.description: WP reference; defaults to the first step's number

title.description: Defaults to a short form of the first step's text

preparer.description: Who prepares it ('me' for me); defaults to the steps' owner

reviewer.description: Who reviews it ('me' for me); defaults to the steps' reviewer

rfi.description: RFI item number or id it waits on

tools.name: update_workpaper
tools.description: Change a work paper: status (cleared / final is refused while review points are open), notes, due date, preparer, reviewer, ref, title, open items (add, resolve or reopen; each can wait on an RFI item), and which worksteps it covers (`steps` sets them exactly; addSteps / removeSteps for single changes).

engagement.description: Needed if the ref exists on several engagements

rfi.description: RFI item number or id it waits on

resolveOpenItems.description: Open item ids, or words from their text

reopenOpenItems.description: Open item ids, or words from their text

steps.description: Exactly the worksteps it covers (numbers or ids)

tools.name: update_workpaper_status
tools.description: Move a work paper through: not_started → in_progress → prepared → in_review → points_raised → cleared → final (cleared / final need every review point cleared). update_workpaper does this and more.

engagement.description: Needed if the ref exists on several engagements

tools.name: add_review_points
tools.description: Add one or more review points (review notes) to a work paper. Sets the WP to points_raised.

raisedBy.description: Who raised them; omit for me

assignedTo.description: Who must address them ('me' for me); omit for the work paper's preparer

due.description: When they should be addressed by

step.description: Work plan step number or id they relate to

tools.name: update_review_point
tools.description: Mark a review point addressed or cleared (or reopen it), reassign it (change its owner), set its due date or link it to a workstep. Pass `ids` to make the same change to several points at once (e.g. give every open point on a work paper to one person).

assignedTo.description: Who must address it ('me' for me; the preparer's name puts it back with the preparer)

step.description: Work plan step number or id; empty to unlink

tools.name: add_irl_items
tools.description: Add items to an engagement's information request list (IRL), e.g. from a pasted email or screenshot. Next chase dates are set automatically.

requestedFrom.description: Client contact's name; created if new

tools.name: update_irl_item
tools.description: Update an RFI / IRL item: mark received / partial / na, change the due date, add our notes, set who to chase, mark whether it is the books (TB / GL / accounting backup), or set / clear its imported columns (e.g. "Remarks (Firm)") with `fields`: an empty value clears that column.

requestedFrom.description: Client contact to chase ('' to clear)

responsible.description: Client's person responsible as a name, when not a contact ('' to clear)

books.description: true / false to mark whether this item is the books; null to go back to the automatic guess

tools.name: reset_chase_dates
tools.description: Set open RFI items' next chase dates by criticality: request date (or last chase) + 3 working days for High, 5 for Medium (also blank), 7 for Low, skipping weekends. Only items with a client contact. Use after the cadence changed or an import set odd dates.

engagement.description: Only this engagement; omit for all

tools.name: log_chase
tools.description: Record that I chased an IRL item or nudged someone on a follow-up today. Moves the next chase date forward.

tools.name: create_followup
tools.description: Track something I'm waiting on from a client, manager or team member.

tools.name: close_followup
tools.description: Mark a follow-up done (I got what I was waiting for).

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Set a reminder that pops up at a given local date and time.

tools.name: log_time
tools.description: Log time worked, against an engagement and optionally a task. Use for timesheet hours.

engagement.description: Engagement id or name; omit for admin/other time

tools.name: weekly_report
tools.description: Summary for a week: items finished, chases, focus sessions, hours by engagement, a timesheet grid, longest-waiting items, overdue count.

weekOf.description: Any date in the week; defaults to this week

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Gamification stats: points, level, today's ring progress, streaks and badges earned.

tools.name: get_work_programme
tools.description: Old name (use get_programme): an engagement's TB-driven work programme: materiality, area balances (current and prior), trend flags, and procedures with status, reviewer outcome and notes. Optionally one area.

tools.name: add_program_items
tools.description: Add procedures (with why) to an engagement's work programme for an area, e.g. extra checks after the reviewer flagged something. Optionally under a flagged step (parentId).

parentId.description: Id of the programme step these follow up on

tools.name: update_program_item
tools.description: Update a work-programme step: preparer status, reviewer outcome (ok / flagged / na) with a note, notes, or assignee.

tools.name: get_workload
tools.description: Everything one person has to complete (or 'me'), optionally on one engagement: work plan steps where they are the person responsible, steps waiting for their review, work papers they prepare or review, tasks, review points assigned to them and work-programme procedures. Use for 'how many items / work papers / steps does X have', 'what is pending with X'.

person.description: Name, first name or initials as used in the work plan, or 'me'

tools.name: get_work_plan
tools.description: Old name (use get_programme): an engagement's imported work plan / audit programme: progress, steps per person, and the steps with number, area, procedure, person responsible, execution status (open / wip / review = review pending / closed), review status, reviewer, risk and hours. Filter by person, status or area.

person.description: Only steps this person is responsible for or reviews

area.description: Area or phase text, e.g. 'Payroll' or 'Balance Sheet'

tools.name: get_readiness
tools.description: Which open work plan steps can be executed now with the inputs received on the RFI, which are blocked (and by which missing RFI items or inputs not on the RFI), which only have suggested links the user hasn't confirmed yet, and which aren't linked to any input. Only confirmed links count as ready or blocked. Optionally for one person. Use for 'what can we do now', 'what's blocked and why', 'what is holding up Asha'.

person.description: Only steps this person is responsible for

includeRfi.description: Also return the engagement's RFI items (number, status, short description), e.g. to link steps with set_step_inputs

tools.name: get_rfi_impact
tools.description: For an RFI item (by number like '3.1', id, or words): every work plan step it feeds, each step's readiness state and owner. Without an item: the open RFI items holding up the most steps. Use for 'what does 1.5 unlock', 'which steps need the bank statements', 'what should we chase first'.

item.description: RFI number ('3.1'), id, or words from its description

tools.name: set_step_inputs
tools.description: Suggest which client inputs work plan steps need, for the Readiness page: RFI item numbers, inputs that aren't on the RFI (e.g. 'GSTR-2B for the period'), or that a step needs no client input. Several steps per call. These are suggestions: they show under To confirm and don't count until the user confirms them in Falcon (only the user can confirm). Steps the user already confirmed or set by hand are skipped. Get step ids and RFI numbers from get_readiness with includeRfi.

step.description: Step id, or its number as shown on the plan (e.g. '7.3')

rfi.description: RFI item numbers the step needs

notOnRfi.description: Inputs the step needs that aren't on the RFI

none.description: True when the step needs no client input

mode.description: replace (default) sets the step's inputs; add keeps what it has and adds these

tools.name: add_point_challenges
tools.description: Save counter-questions on a review point ('have you also checked…?'), each with a one-line why. They show on the point for the reviewer to add or dismiss. Replaces earlier AI questions that are still open.

tools.name: update_plan_step
tools.description: Old name (use update_step): update a workstep: notes, actual hours or person responsible. Closing needs a cleared workpaper (or N/A).

assignee.description: Name as it should show on the plan

tools.name: get_programme
tools.description: An engagement's programme: programmes (work plan areas, renamable) → worksteps (number, text, owner, reviewer, status from the workpaper, RFI readiness, procedures) → the workpaper covering each (ref, title, status). Works without a TB; with one, TB balances and trend flags per programme. Filter by person, status, readiness, area or words. Also lists workpapers covering no step. Replaces get_work_plan and get_work_programme.

person.description: Only steps this person owns, or whose workpaper they prepare / review ('me' for me)

status.description: open, wip, to_review, in_review, points_raised, closed, na, or open_any (not closed)

q.description: Words in the step, an RFI number or a workpaper ref / title

tools.name: update_step
tools.description: Change a workstep: owner, reviewer, N/A (applicable false; its workpaper is kept and unlinked), notes, actual hours, or its procedures (add, tick done, remove). Its status comes from its workpaper: to move it, change the workpaper (update_workpaper), or link one (link_workpaper). Replaces update_plan_step.

step.description: Step id, or its number with the engagement

owner.description: Name as it should show (e.g. 'Asha'), or 'me'

doneProcedures.description: Procedure ids or words from their text, to tick done

removeProcedures.description: Procedure ids or words from their text

tools.name: add_steps
tools.description: Add worksteps (each with optional procedures) to an engagement's programme, e.g. 'Revenue to Collections – map monthly revenue collected to bank' under Sales. Creates the programme if missing. `proceduresFromSteps` turns existing steps into this step's procedures (they're removed as steps). Optionally link a workpaper to the new steps.

programme.description: Programme (area) name, e.g. 'Sales'; created if new

proceduresFromSteps.description: Step ids / numbers to move in as procedures

workpaper.description: Workpaper (id or ref) the new steps are covered by

tools.name: link_workpaper
tools.description: Link worksteps to a workpaper (the steps then show its status) or unlink them. A step already on another workpaper moves to this one. Use update_workpaper with `steps` to set the exact list.

link.description: Step numbers or ids to link

unlink.description: Step numbers or ids to unlink

tools.name: get_guided_review
tools.description: The guided review. Without a workpaper: reviews in progress or recently finished (engagement, workpaper, reviewer, started, progress x/y). With one (id, ref or title): every item in order: firm-wide basics, then per linked workstep the step itself, its checks, procedures and inputs, each with its source, the preparer's mark (done / not done), the reviewer's outcome (pending / ✓ / ⚑ / n.a.), note and linked review point; plus checks for next time and the review points (open / cleared). Firm-library items are kept on the user's device and aren't shown here.

tools.name: update_guided_review
tools.description: Change a workpaper's guided review (always a proposal for the user to accept): set an item's outcome (ok / flagged / na / none) and note, mark it done / not done by the preparer, raise a review point from an item (owned by the preparer unless `assignee` is given), add a check for next time (saved as a procedure on the workstep), or start the review. Item keys come from get_guided_review. Set reminders with create_task.

text.description: Point text; default: the item and its note

step.description: Step number or id; default the first linked step

tools.name: batch
tools.description: Several changes in one call, accepted by the user together as one proposal: e.g. create a task and then update it, or add steps and create the workpaper that covers them. Each call names a write tool and its input. Give a call `as: "t1"` and later inputs can use "$t1" wherever an id is expected, for the record that call created (it doesn't exist until the user accepts).

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Delete a record. First call without confirmed to get a preview, show it to the user, and only call again with confirmed: true after they agree.

tools.name: list_proposals
tools.description: Changes waiting for the user's approval (your proposals and those from imports), with what each would change. You can't approve or reject them; only the user can, in Falcon's Inbox. Use to check whether earlier proposals were accepted.

tools.name: undo_last
tools.description: Undo the most recent change made through this chat.
